# Armedia — Web Development & Media Agency Auckland

> Armedia is an Auckland-based web development and media agency
> helping NZ businesses with websites, media, AI workflows,
> business intelligence, and growth strategy.

## Services
- Web development (Next.js, React, custom builds)
- SEO and search visibility
- Media planning and advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
- AI marketing automation
- Business intelligence and reporting dashboards
- OOH and offline media
- CRM and sales systems

## Location
Auckland, New Zealand. Also serving Wellington, Christchurch, Queenstown.
